### A Question of Authority
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/question-authority
Passage: Matthew 21:23-27
Points:
- Religious leaders confronted Jesus in the temple to trap Him into claiming human or divine authority.
- Jesus turned the challenge back on His opponents by asking them about the authority behind John the Baptist.
- Fearful of the crowd yet unwilling to believe John, the leaders chose self-preservation over the truth and claimed ignorance.
- By exposing their lack of moral integrity and authority to examine Him, Jesus rightfully withheld an answer.
- Submitting to the light God has already provided is essential for receiving further spiritual truth and insight.
